mapper.select:
select ol.*, u.name operateUserName from operate_log ol left join user u on ol.operate_user_id = u.id
and u.name like concat('%', #{operateLogDto.operateUserName}, '%')
and ol.class_name like concat('%', #{operateLogDto.className}, '%')
and ol.method_name like concat('%', #{operateLogDto.methodName}, '%')
order by ol.operate_time desc
